records.rationale: Retain x86 selftest headers, Binderfs/breakpoint and tests.zip packaging through final ACK rules. CPU-ABI copy helper moved from abi.bzl to bazel/abi.bzl and now uses android_filegroup/pkg_files, not obsolete copy_file plumbing. ARM target/config and historical step-after-suspend rule omitted or superseded; current selected tests.zip positively consumes x86 and x86_64 groups.

Retain final Binderfs/breakpoint naming, kcmp/ptrace/RTC/vDSO/size-test build rules and x86 runner selections. Original vDSO clock_getres standalone target has no final ACK residual; current native vDSO test set is used. Other-architecture packaging is not introduced; no original kernel implementation is altered by these rules.

Retain dual GPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 licensing in relocated bazel/abi.bzl and selected x86 metadata. Original abi.bzl path is gone, ARM suite config omitted. License URLs read as local text only. This is build-source licensing, not kernel-module KMI.

Omit 32-bit ARM suite/selection/runner for the x86 SDK target; retain shared final ABI helper including its declarative CPU list rather than forking macro API used by x86 callers. ARM configurations and package rules are absent, so this does not enable an ARM kernel or runtime platform. Candidate also had erroneous :x86 breakpoint selector superseded by current android_i386 rule.

Retain 32-bit x86 ABI copies and x86 selftest group alongside x86_64 in existing tests.zip. This is userspace compat testing on the selected 64-bit kernel, not another kernel platform. Current platform selector uses android_i386 and macro maps x86 output directory to i386 CPU. Archive contains both ELF32 i386 and ELF64 x86_64 binaries; execution is unverified.

Retain final Android KUnit README and x86 Tradefed XML relocation/packaging. Old XML locations remain absent and ARM KUnit target is omitted. Superseded standalone package visibility follows final SDK rule graph. README examples and embedded remote links were not executed or contacted.

Retain final KUnit README evolution and module/config packaging through the common distribution. Original standalone kunit_tests_*_install rules are superseded and outside selected build closure; current BUILD has no such standalone target. Documentation is inherited ACK guidance, not evidence its separate device instructions were exercised.

Retain tests_zip_x86_64 in common-kernel extra_dist, including KUnit and selftests; actual existing build emits it. Separate ARM target and historical KUnit defconfig are superseded/omitted. Do not restore commented KFENCE test-module selection or old separate kunit build: current native KFENCE runtime configuration is independently reviewed.

Omit Gerrit OWNERS reviewer/per-file authorization rules, including wildcard TEST_MAPPING/XML ownership. These affect external review routing only, not source compilation, native kernel authorization or required emulator artifacts. No remote identity or policy was queried.

Retain modular KUnit, selected test modules and final x86 package/module lists while excluding tests from system_dlkm production list. Preserve KUNIT_DEFAULT_ENABLED=n and native KUNIT_DEBUGFS behavior. Original x86 system_dlkm accidental arm64 list is not reproduced: final uses x86_64. Omit separate ARM/Cuttlefish launcher/JDK/Tradefed shell workflows and old test defconfigs. Compiling/packaging modules is not loading or executing tests.

Retain forced Bionic compatibility include/header dependency in selftest cc rules and final _GNU_SOURCE/sys/types definitions. 7eab0e190225 removes original pthread_cancel false-success stub; Android thread-cancel test now reports an explicit skip while other libc behavior and native process tests remain. This prevents misleading test results and leaked spinning test thread, without changing kernel syscall/security implementations.

Retain final shared VTS XML metadata but omit standalone vts_tests.zip/install/ABI grouping rules: existing SDK build produces standard tests.zip and has no VTS target dependency. Binderfs is already included in standard x86 package. XML is not executed and retaining harness descriptions does not enable an ARM or Cuttlefish kernel.

Retain final VTS network test descriptions; standard SDK package already supplies psock_tpacket/reuseaddr/socket under existing non-tests-prefixed rule names. Separate VTS duplicate rules, psock library and reuseport_dualstack package are outside selected workflow. Native network tests/source remain; no kernel socket behavior is changed or test pass inferred.

Retain final VTS breakpoint metadata and standard x86 breakpoint package. Standalone VTS group changes are outside selected workflow; native breakpoint kernel and test source are preserved, without enabling ARM platform.

Retain final VTS RTC description and existing standard RTC binary. Standalone VTS group changes omitted. Native RTC source/tests remain; source inspection cannot establish SDK interrupt/alarm operation and no clock was changed or suspended.

Retain futex headers, current individual binaries and ABI output filenames. Original run.sh aggregation is superseded by individual runner entries; obsolete waitv standalone rule absent from final ACK, while native waitv source remains. Shared cc/sh helper API remains at final ACK; no script/test was run. Current native futex tests and explicit configured-feature skips are reviewed separately.

Retain all nineteen timer compile targets in selected x86 distribution with current common compiler options and native source. Final ACK suite removes destructive/time-changing invocations; binary packaging is not execution. 29bc8be5e229 uses LTS timer header set, and 7eab0e190225 avoids false Bionic cancellation. Kernel timekeeping fixes are not reverted to match old tests.

Retain MM/hugetlb/mlock/mremap/userfaultfd binaries and shared vm_util/uffd libraries in current x86 packaging. Tests can compile for optional/disabled runtime features; source availability is not proof those features are enabled or tests pass. Native MM kernel fixes and separately reviewed source compatibility corrections remain.

Retain removal of the suspend-dependent breakpoint target and runner invocation from final SDK suite; native test source remains. This removes a default device-test selection, not breakpoint or suspend kernel support. No suspend was performed.

Retain individual futex command selection and removal of aggregate run.sh rule; final metadata supersedes historical time/argument variants. Built archive has all current referenced executables, retaining skip/KTAP semantics. No aggregate or individual futex test executed.

Retain psock_tpacket/reuseaddr_conflict/socket builds and selected Tradefed commands using final compiler flags and native test sources with separately reviewed compatibility fixes. These are standard SDK package inputs, distinct from later VTS duplicate rules; no network traffic or socket test performed.

Retain capability execve/helper and seccomp selftest compile rules, libc compatibility flags and selected suite commands. validate_cap is packaged as sibling executable for its caller; later explicit standalone invocation add/revert is already reviewed. Native capability and seccomp access controls are unaffected; no test executed.

Retain all six x86-specific register/LDT-GDT/ptrace/syscall-step/NT/vDSO-remap test rules with final x86 and x86_64 packaging. Static link/optimization choices compile userspace test programs, not kernel security policy. Source/native fixes are preserved and no ptrace, descriptor or register test was run.

Retain memfd common library/header and memfd_test build/runner entry in selected x86_64 package. Current common compiler/dependency rules compile native-source tests; this adds no memfd permission or sealing change and does not claim a runtime test result.

Retain final VTS capabilities descriptions and standard x86 capability helper/binary packaging. Candidate all-architecture VTS lists are not selected by existing SDK workflow; no additional kernel platform. The historical standalone helper invocation is not a new runtime requirement or asserted test pass.

Retain final VTS individual futex descriptions and existing standard x86 futex package. Separate all-architecture VTS group expansion omitted from selected SDK rules; final metadata names are used. Kernel futex implementations and source-level skip decisions are not changed.

Retain final VTS kcmp metadata and existing standard x86 kcmp package. Standalone VTS all-architecture lists are unselected; this does not enable another platform or alter kernel kcmp authorization. Archive compilation is verified, test execution is not.

Actual generated SDK virtual configuration. Test framework is modular and disabled by default; compilation does not run it.

method: Enumerated every original changed path and extracted every metadata delta; reviewed declarative rule names/source/dependency/compiler/ABI packaging and normalized XML commands/preparers. Full original helper, Bionic header, KUnit configuration/module/launcher patches additionally read. Matched final selected targets and exact ACK helpers/XML, checked actual tests.zip read-only. This is metadata/source review, not a claim of executing or runtime-validating the tests.
